content: Our production deployment uses ArgoCD for GitOps-based Kubernetes delivery. Manifests in the deploy/ directory are automatically synced to the cluster on merge to main.

Helm charts for the kubernetes deployment are in charts/ironclaw/. Values files per environment: values-dev.yaml, values-staging.yaml, values-prod.yaml. Resource limits and replica counts vary by tier.
Container images are built in CI and pushed to ghcr.io. The kubernetes deployment pipeline runs: lint -> test -> build -> push -> deploy-staging -> smoke-test -> deploy-prod.
Rust's cargo build system compiles dependencies in parallel. The target/ directory caches intermediate artifacts. Use cargo build --release for optimized binaries with LTO enabled.
SSH key rotation should happen quarterly. Use ed25519 keys for new servers. The authorized_keys file should be managed through configuration management, not manual edits.
